_source: Macrostrat map sources, as named in https://macrostrat.org/api/v2/defs/sources?all=true&format=csv and https://macrostrat.org/api/v2/defs/sources?source_id=... (read 14 November 2026). Every source here whose name says basement, aeromagnetic, magnetic, buried, subsurface or 'Precambrian surface' must be in BASEMENT_SOURCES, and every 1:1,000,000 '4° x 6° quadrangle' Quaternary sheet in REGIONAL_SOURCES (src/lib/ground-layers.ts); scripts/check-ground.ts checks both. The scale of the 4° x 6° sheets is from the references of 504, 509, 521 and 531 ('scale 1:1,000,000'); 507, 528, 539 and 540 are 1:500,000 by their references.
